name: darktable
summary: [darktable](https://www.darktable.org/) is an open source photography workflow application and raw developer. A virtual lighttable and darkroom for photographers. It manages your digital negatives in a database, lets you view them through a zoomable lighttable and enables you to develop raw images and enhance them.

ports.description: Darktable desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and images
